title: From lot records to the next operating decision
intro: For semiconductor equipment-component suppliers, progress and quality information becomes useful when the source, scope and decision owner are clear.

sections.heading: Start with one handoff
paragraphs: Choose one production lot and the planning decision that needs its progress or quality status. Identify the source record, when it was updated, and what it covers.
Agree who checks a mismatch, who receives the confirmed information and what evidence they need before the next step.

sections.heading: Keep planning and production evidence in their roles
paragraphs: ERP supports enterprise orders, materials, planning and costs. Manufacturing execution solutions support production progress, lot records and quality information.
Map the information each team needs before defining the solution scope and data handoff.

sections.heading: Semiconductor industry context: Wafer Works
paragraphs: Wafer Works / 合晶科技, Taiwan / Shanghai, produces silicon wafer materials. The case covers crystal growth, wafer processing and epitaxy.
Digiwin describes production genealogy from silicon crystals to wafer lots, visibility into production progress and equipment status, and epitaxy history with quality parameter limits.
For an equipment-component supplier, these are useful questions about traceability and execution visibility to bring into its own process discussion.

sections.heading: Define the fit with the team in Vietnam
paragraphs: Digiwin Vietnam specialists assess factory operations, advise on business processes and support on-site solution transfer and factory acceptance.

Bring a current production-to-planning handoff to the discussion: its records, the people involved, the receiving decision and the gaps to resolve. This helps define the processes and implementation scope for your factory.
